title: An EFHD1-associated ADSC niche modulates treatment response in experimental models of ER-positive breast cancer.
snippet: Adipose-derived stem cells (ADSCs) modulate the breast cancer (BC) microenvironment, but their role in endocrine therapy resistance and clinical outcomes remains ill-defined. title: A dendritic cell-related prognostic signature in glioma: A multi-omic framework integrating transcriptomics, single-cell profiling, and clinical validation.
snippet: Dendritic cells (DCs) infiltrating the glioma microenvironment can promote antitumor immunity or contribute to immunosuppression and immune escape. title: Integrated multi-omics and experimental analyses characterize an IGF2BP3-MMP7-associated pattern in extracellular matrix remodeling and Treg-associated immune suppression in pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD) is characterized by extensive extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling and a profoundly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment.
